headline: Hospital giant flags $400 million hit from policy change
summary: HCA Healthcare (HCA), the United States' largest hospital chain, beat Wall Street on both revenue and profit for the second quarter, then watched its own stock fall anyway. The reason sits inside a single line item: a roughly $400 million pre-tax hit tied to patients losing health insurance ...
